column1: #: description: Acceptance as a function of the generator-level $p_\text{T}$ of the leading and subleading lepton in SR-$ee$ from $\tilde{e}$ decays. The plot is made from signal Monte Carlo events with $\tilde{\ell}$ with mass of 400 GeV and lifetime of 1 ns. To be accepted
column2: events are required to have at least 2 truth leptons with $p_\text{T} > 65$ GeV
column5: and $\Delta R_{\ell\ell} > 0.2$. Events are also required to fall into one of the acceptance regions of the triggers used. At generator level
column6: events must have one of the following: one electron with $p_\text{T} >$ 160 GeV
column8: or 1 muon with $p_\text{T} >$ 60 GeV and $|\eta| < 1.07$. The overflow is not shown in these plots.
